briefings.title: The Digital Fairness Act: Keynote Address by Isabelle Pérignon

people.name: Isabelle Pérignon
people.role: Director for Consumer Policy, European Commission

briefings.tldr: The upcoming Digital Fairness Act (DFA)—a flagship initiative of EU Commissioner Michael McGrath scheduled for adoption under the Irish EU Presidency—aims to modernize consumer protection by banning manipulative online practices like dark patterns and dynamic pricing.
